name: Safe Noclip
description: Adds a noclip toggle button in-game (green = on, red = off). Includes a SafeMode that prevents the level from being counted as completed when noclip was used.

noclip-enabled.name: Noclip enabled by default
noclip-enabled.description: Whether noclip is on when you enter a level.

show-button.name: Show toggle button
show-button.description: Show the on-screen noclip toggle button.

green-means-on.name: Green = noclip ON
green-means-on.description: If true, the button is green when noclip is active and red when off. Flip this to invert the colours.

safe-mode.name: SafeMode (block counted completions)
safe-mode.description: When enabled, a level completed with noclip active is NOT counted as a real completion.
